name: pointmeasure-3d
description: PointMeasure 3D desktop app for PLY point cloud measurement.

scripts.dev: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && tsx scripts/start-electron-dev.ts"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:electron
scripts.build:electron: esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs --external:electron && esbuild src/preload/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs --external:electron && esbuild src/main/floorplan/worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=cjs --outfile=dist-electron/floorplan-worker.cjs
